svg.aria-label: 6G2 · eyelet board layout — redrawn board layout diagram
svg.text: Redrawn from Fender "Princeton" Model 6G2 layout drawing (H-FA) — title block reads "FENDER 'PRINCETON' LAYOUT MODEL 6G2 H-FA", matching the schematic's own H-FA drawing number — not a trace

Heater layer: the one part of this board not established against the amplifier's own drawing. At the centre-tapped valve (V2) it shows the two heater pins on opposite supply legs — the 12.6 V series arrangement; a 6.3 V supply straps them into one leg and returns on the centre tap. The link drawn
between V1 pins 5 and 9 joins the supply's two legs and cannot be right either way. Which sockets sit on the chain, and the order it reaches them in, are not affected.
Note: the heater wiring always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
6.3 V heaters — twisted pair (leg grouping not established)
6.3 V heaters — single lead (leg grouping not established)
